description: The Pipedrive write log of this tenant: every create/update/delete the connector sent to Pipedrive, newest first, with time, who/which agent, tool, object, Pipedrive id, the record's name (title/name/subject), payload hash and outcome (including the error Pipedrive returned). Read it as it is — names are in the log, no need to look them up. Read-only.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

tool_name.description: Only entries written by this tool

name: list_pipedrive_write_log
